scenario.suspicion_context: You are in the office late at night, and the security guard has noticed unusual activity in the building. He's been working late and seems suspicious of your presence.
scenario.player_backstory: You claim to be a contractor here to work on a special project, but you seem nervous and overly curious about the security measures.

clues.description: A metal bar with a screwdriver tip, used for forced entry.

Tool has grease and oil residue
No legitimate reason for such a tool to be present
clues.supports: Hinders the player's claim of innocence
